snippet.title: BEAST HUNT - Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Beast Hunt, a 3D cave crawling deduction horror.

Hunt your way through a dense network of tunnels and caves, all while being chased by a giant spider who gets angrier the lower your sanity falls.  Manage your resources, defeat the Beast, and make it out of the hunt alive!
